# lookupv1

```go
import lookupv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/instance/lookup/v1"
```

Package lookupv1 is the instance.lookup/v1 contract: a multisite host asks for a hostname it doesn't know. A companion to instance.source/v1 for sources that don't hold every instance (a lazy mirror of a control plane): the host asks on every request it can't route, and the provider answers from its cache or fetches.

A host-scope service contract; ext/mothership/client provides it beside instance.source/v1.

Source: [`ext/contracts/instance/lookup/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/instance/lookup/v1).

## Variables

<a id="contract"></a>

```go
var Contract = extkit.NewContract[Lookup]("instance.lookup/v1", extkit.One)
```

Contract is instance.lookup/v1.

## Types

### Lookup

```go
type Lookup interface {
	// Lookup returns the instance host routes to. Found false (with a nil error) means no instance has the name; an
	// error means the answer isn't known (the control plane can't be reached), so the host answers 503, not 404.
	Lookup(ctx context.Context, host string) (Result, error)
}
```

Lookup answers what a hostname serves.

### Result

```go
type Result struct {
	Found    bool
	Instance sourcev1.Instance
}
```

Result is a lookup's answer.
